name: workflow_run
description: Start a workflow in a new isolated session. The workflow executes deterministically — nodes run in the defined order without agent decisions, except at 'agent' and 'decide' nodes where the session's agent participates. Returns the new session ID immediately; execution continues in the background session.

workflowId.description: ID of the workflow to run (matches the workflow file name without .json)

input.description: Input values passed to the workflow's input node. Must be a JSON object, not a string.

agentId.description: Optional. Agent to use for the workflow session. Defaults to the calling agent.
